findings.note: The invoice describes the same article in different words; quantity, unit price and line total match the purchase order.
The invoice address carries the country at the end; the street, number and city are the same.

summary: The invoice matches the purchase order on every amount. Line 3 names the ordered printer paper differently and the vendor address includes the country, so the difference is presentation only.
rejectionEmailHtml:
Dear Supplier,

We have received invoice INV-88757045 against purchase order PO-98476545 and found the following differences:

  • Line 3 description: "Heavyweight printer paper large" on the invoice, "Printer Paper Large" on the purchase order.
  • Vendor address: the invoice adds the country to the address.

Please confirm that these refer to the ordered articles so we can release the payment.

Kind regards,
Payments Team
